verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal runs online filing and registry services, so offering an API with scoped credentials for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no API, no credential issuance and no permission scoping. The items on representatives (mandatários) and licenses are legal IP-rights concepts, not API access controls, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
